text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian fails to reach first place at the Kikuka Sho. She silently acknowledges her own shortcomings…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she won't stop here. She resolves to temper herself and grow even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon, who Narita Brian is still planning on facing in the Arima Kinen, is surely growing stronger as well…
